description_sq:
Shitet apartament me siperfaqe totale 167m2 ne Rrugen Mujo Ulqinaku, rruge e cila lidh zonen e Myslym Shyrit me ate te rruges se Kavajes, ne nje pallat te ri te sapo perfunduar. 
Organizohet ne 3 dhomat gjumi, 2 tualete, dhome ndenje, kuzhine e vecuar dhe nje ballkon me dalje ne dhomen matrimoniale e ate te ndenjies.
Pamja nga Rruga e Kavajes.
Ky ndertim ofron cilesine me te mire te ndertimit duke u pozicionuar ne qender te qytetit te Tiranes, me akses ne cdo facilitet, afersi me te gjitha institutionet shteterore e publike te vendit etj.
Per me teper infomacion na kontaktoni!
description_en: Apartment for sale with a total area of ​​167m2 on Mujo Ulqinaku Street, a street that connects the area of ​​Myslym Shyr with that of Kavaje Street, in a newly completed building. It is organized in 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, living room, separate kitchen and a balcony with access to the master bedroom and the living room. The view from Kavaje Street. This building offers the best quality of construction, being positioned in the center of the city of Tirana, with access to every facility, proximity to all state and public institutions of the country, etc. For more information, contact us!
